description: Six engineers, one deadline, and an unreasonable amount of confidence.
summary: Coming into this challenge, we wanted to push ourselves out of our comfort zone by diving headfirst into AI-assisted development to see how fast we could turn an idea into reality. While we may not have crossed the finish line with a working product this time around, we learned a ton, had a great time collaborating under pressure, and are already excited to put these new skills to work in future challenges!
details:
This project marked our first experience building and shipping a solution using AI-assisted development. Throughout the process, we dedicated significant effort to understanding the concepts, learning the tooling, structuring our workflow, and aiming for a polished final product, pushing really hard to bring our idea to life.

Due to tight time constraints, the work became heavily rushed, which affected our implementation, documentation, and presentation. As a result, we were ultimately unable to get a fully functioning version over the finish line before the deadline. Even so, it has been an awesome learning experience for the team, and we’re already looking forward to taking everything we learned here and coming back stronger for the next one!
